paite: Huchi in Solomon in Israel upate, anam intekpen tengteng Israel suan inkuan a lupente, Jerusalem a kumpipa Solomon kiang ah David khopi, Zion a pan TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngtou ding in akaikhawm vek hi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm Tempul A Laklut Ahi / (2 Kro 5.2-6.2)
english: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel with all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel, to King Solomon in Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahweh’s covenant out of David’s city, which is Zion.

paite: Israel mi tengteng Ethanim kha, akha sagihna ah, ankuangluina ah kumpipa Solomon kiang ah akikaikhawm vek uhi.
english: All the men of Israel assembled themselves to King Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

paite: Israel upa tengteng ahong ua, siampute'n bawm azawng uhi.
english: All the elders of Israel came, and the priests picked up the ark.

paite: TOUPA bawm leh Kihoupihna Puanin leh puanin a tui-um belsuan siangthou tengteng tan in siampute leh Levi chite'n azawngtou uhi.
english: They brought up Yahweh’s ark, the Tent of Meeting, and all the holy vessels that were in the Tent. The priests and the Levites brought these up.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon leh Israel suan omkhawm tengteng akiang a hong kikhawmte bawm ma ah a-omkhawm uh. Belam leh bawngtal atam ziak a sim seng vual louh leh azah theihseng vual louh in akithoih uhi.
english: King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, who were assembled to him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and cattle that could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

paite: Siampute'n TOUPA thukhun bawm omna ding, insung a biakna mun a Mun Siangthoupen ah cherubte kha nuai ah alalut uhi.
english: The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most holy place, even under the cherubim’s wings.

paite: Cherubte'n bawm omna tung zawn ah akha uh azak gige ngal ua, cherubte'n bawm leh azawnna chiangtawnte ahuap vek uhi.
english: For the cherubim spread their wings out over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and its poles above.

paite: Azawnna chiangtawn asau mahmah ziak in, azawnna chiangtawn mongte biakna mun ma, mun siangthou a pan amuh theih hi. Himahleh inn polam ah zaw adawk kei, tuni tan huai ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the holy place before the inner sanctuary, but they were not seen outside. They are there to this day.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan apawt ua TOUPA Israel suante toh thu akhun lai a Mosi in Horeb tang a suangpek nih akoihte kia lou ngal, huai bawm sung ah bangmah dang a-om kei.
english: There was nothing in the ark except the two stone tablets which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahweh made a covenant with the children of Israel, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute Mun Siangthou a pan ahong pawt khiaktak un meipi in TOUPA' inn ahong dim meuhmouh hi.
english: It came to pass, when the priests had come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled Yahweh’s house,

paite: Meipi ziak in siampute nasem in a-om thei kei uh. TOUPA thupina in TOUPA' inn lah adimsak vek ngal a.
english: so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.

paite: Solomon in thu agen a: "TOUPA'N, mial bikbek ah ka om ding," achi hi.
english: Then Solomon said, “Yahweh has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

paite: "Na tenna ding in, tangtawn a na om gigena ding inn ka hon lamsak petmah hi,” achi hi.
english: I have surely built you a house of habitation, a place for you to dwell in forever.”

paite: Kumpipa akinunghei a, Israel kikaikhawm tengteng avualzawl a, Israel kikaikhawm tengteng adingh dipdep uhi.
heading: Mipite Kiang A Solomon Thugen / (2 Kro 6.3-11)
english: The king turned his face around and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

paite: Ama'n, "TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, ka na David kiang a amah kam mahmah a,
english: He said, “Blessed is Yahweh, the God of Israel, who spoke with his mouth to David your father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

paite: Aigupta gam a pan ka mi Israelte ka pikhiak ni a pan Israel nam lak a koi lai khua leng ka min omna ding, inn lamna ding ka tel ngei kei hi. Himahleh ka mi Israelte heutu ding in David ka tel hi, chi a ana genpa, amah khut mahmah a hon pichingsakpa phat in om hen.
english: ‘Since the day that I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Israel to build a house, that my name might be there; but I chose David to be over my people Israel.’

paite: "Ka pa David in Israelte' Pathian, TOUPA min dia inn lam alungsim in ana tum hi.
english: “Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N ka pa David kiang ah, 'Na lungsim in ka min a ding in inn lam na tum a, hichibang lungsim na put na hihhoih hi.
english: But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

paite: Himahleh nang zaw, inn na lam kei ding. Na tapa, na khal a hong pawtkhe ding in ka min a ding in inn alam zaw ding," ana chi hi.
english: Nevertheless, you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come out of your body, he shall build the house for my name.’

paite: "TOUPA'N athugen ahihkip a; TOUPA'N ana chiamsa bang ngei in ka pa David mun ka hon luah in, Israel laltutphah ah ka hong tuta a, Israelte' Pathian, TOUPA min a ding in inn ka na lamta ngei hi.
english: Yahweh has established his word that he spoke; for I have risen up in the place of David my father, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as Yahweh promised, and have built the house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Huai ah bawm omna ding mun ka na sep a, huai ah Aigupta gam a pan apikhiak lai a i pute uh kiang a athukhun, TOUPA thukhun a-om,” achi hi.
english: There I have set a place for the ark, in which is Yahweh’s covenant, which he made with our fathers when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.”

paite: TOUPA maitam ma, Israel hong kikhawm tengteng muh in Solomon adingh a, van lam ah akhut azaktou hi.
heading: Solomon Thumna / (2 Kro 6.2-42)
english: Solomon stood before Yahweh’s altar in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and spread out his hands toward heaven;

paite: "AW TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian, na sikha lungtang tengteng na mitmuh a omte kiang a thukhun tangtun a hehpihna hihlang zel, na sikha ka pa David kiang a thuchiam tangtunpa, tunglam ah leh nuailam lei ah nang bang Pathian dang a-om kei.
english: and he said, “Yahweh, the God of Israel, there is no God like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath; who keeps covenant and loving kindness with your servants who walk before you with all their heart;

paite: Ahi, nang na kam in thu na gen a, na khut in na hon lohchingsakta a, tuni a, hong omta ngei bang in.
english: who has kept with your servant David my father that which you promised him. Yes, you spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is today.

paite: Huaiziak in aw TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, na sikha ka pa David kiang a, na suante ka mitmuh a na om bang a ka mitmuh a om sam ding a a-omdan uh apilvan peuhmah uleh ka mitmuh in Israelte laltutphah a tu ding na tatlak kei ding, chi a na chiam tangtun in.
english: Now therefore, may Yahweh, the God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, ‘There shall not fail from you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk before me as you have walked before me.’

paite: Aw Israelte' Pathian, na sikha ka pa David kiang a thu na gensa hehpih in tungsak in."
english: “Now therefore, God of Israel, please let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant David my father.

paite: "Himahleh lei ah Pathian ateng mahmah dia hia? Ngai in, van leh vante' van a leng ta lou na hi a; hiai ka inn lam ah nak tat tuak kei na tel chia!
english: But will God in very deed dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens can’t contain you; how much less this house that I have built!

paite: Himahleh TOUPA ka Pathian, tuni a na sikha in ahon sapna thumna, athusam ngaihkhiaksak in, na sikha thumna leh ngetna hon limsak in.
english: Yet have respect for the prayer of your servant and for his supplication, Yahweh my God, to listen to the cry and to the prayer which your servant prays before you today;

paite: Hiai mun lam nga a na sikha in thum a thu asam ding ngaikhia a, nang, huai ah ka min a-om ding, na chihna mun ngei a, inn lam a sun leh zan a na mit ahah gige theihna ding in.
english: that your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, ‘My name shall be there;’ to listen to the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

paite: Na sikha leh na mi Israelte'n hiai mun lam nga a, ahong thum chiang un angetnate uh na ngaihkhiaksak zel in. Ahi, na tenna mun, van ah na ngaikhia in; ngaikhia inla, ngaidam in." \
english: Listen to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Israel, when they pray toward this place. Yes, hear in heaven, your dwelling place; and when you hear, forgive.

paite: "Mi kuapeuh in a-invengte tung ah thil hihkhial in, kichiamsak hial ahong kiphatmohleh hiai inn a na maitam ma ah hong kichiam henla,
english: “If a man sins against his neighbor, and an oath is laid on him to cause him to swear, and he comes and swears before your altar in this house,

paite: nang van ah na ngaikhia inla, gamtang inla na sikhate vai hawmsak in, migilou pen mohpaih in alutung ah a-omdan nga inla, midiktat pen siamtangsak in adiktatna bangbang amah pia in.
english: then hear in heaven, and act, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way on his own head, and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

paite: Na mi Israelte'n na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua melmate lak a avuallelh ua nang lam ahong ngat nawn ua, na min aphat ua, hiai inn a thum a thil ahon nget uleh,
english: “When your people Israel are struck down before the enemy because they have sinned against you, if they turn again to you and confess your name, and pray and make supplication to you in this house,

paite: nang van ah ana ngaihkhiaksak inla, na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, apute uh gam na piak ah pikik nawn in."
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Israel, and bring them again to the land which you gave to their fathers.

paite: "Na tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ua van akikhak a, vuah ahong zuk louh hun chiang in, hiai mun lam nga a ahong thum ua, na min apuankhiak ua, amau na bawl gentheih ziak a akhelhnate uh akisik uleh,
english: “When the sky is shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against you, if they pray toward this place and confess your name, and turn from their sin when you afflict them,

paite: nang van ah ana ngaikhia inla, na sikhate leh na mi Israelte khelhna ngaidam inla, apaina ding uh lampi hoih sinsak inla, na mite goutan dia na piakna gam ah vuah zusak in."
english: then hear in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, when you teach them the good way in which they should walk; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

paite: "Ka gam ua kial ahong kiak a, hipi ahong len a, keuna hiam, muatna hiam, khaukhup hiam, lung hiam ahong om a, amelmate un akongpi kim ua ahong um ua, hipi khatpeuh, chinatna bangpeuh ahong tunleh,
english: “If there is famine in the land, if there is pestilence, if there is blight, mildew, locust or caterpillar; if their enemy besieges them in the land of their cities, whatever plague, whatever sickness there is,

paite: na mi Israel tengteng lak a amau lungtang a hipi om hi a thei a, hiai inn lam nga a khut zankhia a, thumna leh ngetna ahon lat uleh;
english: whatever prayer and supplication is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, who shall each know the plague of his own heart, and spread out his hands toward this house,

paite: na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, ngaidam inla, gamtang inla, nang alungtang uh theipa, michih a-omdan bangbang in lohchingsak in; nang, nang kia lah mihing ta tengteng lungtang theipa na hi ngal a.
english: then hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and forgive, and act, and give to every man according to all his ways, whose heart you know (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men);

paite: Ka pute uh na piak gam a aten lai teng uh nang ahon lauhtheihna ding un."
english: that they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.

paite: "Na mi Israelte hilou namdang, na min ziak a gam gamlapi a pan hong paite tungtang thu leng;
english: “Moreover, concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he comes out of a far country for your name’s sake

paite: na min thupi mahmah, na khut hat mahmah, na ban na zak thu na za chiat ding ahi ngal ua, huaite'n hiai inn lam nga a, ahong thum chiang un,
english: (for they shall hear of your great name and of your mighty hand and of your outstretched arm), when he comes and prays toward this house,

paite: nang na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, namdang in hon nget ana hihsak in. Na mi Israelte bangmah a leitung mite'n na min atheih ua, laudan ahong siam ua, hiai ka inn lam in na min pu ahi chih ahon theihtheihna ding un."
english: hear in heaven, your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

paite: "Na mite'n amelmate uh na sawlna lamlam ah adou ua, na khopi tel lam nga leh na min a dia ka lam inn lam nga a, TOUPA kiang a ahong thum uleh,
english: “If your people go out to battle against their enemy, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to Yahweh toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name,

paite: athumna uleh angetna uh nang van ah ana ngaikhia inla, athu uah gamtang in."
english: then hear in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

paite: "Na tung a thil ahihkhelh uleh, kuamah thil hihkhial lou lah a-om ngal kei a; atung ua na hehna, melma gam gamla mahmah hiam, naichik hiam a leng sal a api ua;
english: If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to the land of the enemy, far off or near;

paite: sal a apina gam ua ahong kingaihtuahkhiak ua, akisik ua, thil i na hihkhialta, dikloutak leh gilou mahmah in i na gamta uh, chi a sal a pi mite gam a nang ahon nget uleh,
english: yet if they repent in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of those who carried them captive, saying, ‘We have sinned and have done perversely; we have dealt wickedly,’

paite: amelma amau sal a pite gam a alungtangtak uleh alungsimtak ua nang lam ahong ngat ua, apute uh na piak gam lam leh na khopi tel lam leh na min a dia ka inn lamlam nga a na kiang a ahong thum uleh;
english: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their enemies who carried them captive, and pray to you toward their land which you gave to their fathers, the city which you have chosen and the house which I have built for your name,

paite: athumna uleh angetna uh nang na omna van ah ana ngaikhia inla, athu uah gamtang in.
english: then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, your dwelling place, and maintain their cause;

paite: Na mi na tung a thil hihkhialte leh na tung a ana tatlekna uah atatleknate tengteng uh ngaidam inla; sal a pite'n ahehpih theihna ding un hehpihna neisak in.
english: and forgive your people who have sinned against you, and all their transgressions in which they have transgressed against you; and give them compassion before those who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them

paite: Na mi na goutan, Aigupta gam a pan sik haltuina sung a pan na pikhiakte lah ahi ngal ua."
english: (for they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out of Egypt, from the middle of the iron furnace);

paite: "Ahon sap chiang ua na ngaihkhiak dia, na sikha ngetna leh na mi Israelte ngetna lam a na mit na hah gige theihna ding in.
english: that your eyes may be open to the supplication of your servant and to the supplication of your people Israel, to listen to them whenever they cry to you.

paite: Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ka pute uh Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak lai a na sikha Mosi zang a na gen bang in na goutan ding in leitung mite lak a pan na hihtuam lah ahi ngal ua,” achi hi.
english: For you separated them from among all the peoples of the earth to be your inheritance, as you spoke by Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, Lord Yahweh.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Solomon in TOUPA kiang a athumna leh ngetna tengteng agen khit in, TOUPA maitam ma a khukdin a, van lam a akhut zaktou a om lai athou hi.
heading: Thumna Nanung
english: It was so, that when Solomon had finished praying all this prayer and supplication to Yahweh, he arose from before Yahweh’s altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread out toward heaven.

paite: Adingtou a, aw ngaihtak in Israel kikhawm tengteng avualzawl hi.
english: He stood and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,

paite: "Athuchiam tengteng bang zel a, ami Israelte khawlna pepa TOUPA phat in om hen. Asikha Mosi zang a athuchiam hoih tengteng thu khat leng avuaksuak kei," chi in.
english: “Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by Moses his servant.

paite: "TOUPA i Pathian, i pute kiang a a-om bang in i kiang uah om henla; hon paisan in hon donsak lou kei hen.
english: May Yahweh our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us,

paite: Huchi in alampi tengteng tawn ding leh i pipute ana piak khitsa bang a, athupiakte, adan thusehte, avaihawmte zui dia i lungtangte ama lam a angatsak theihna ding in.
english: that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers.

paite: Asikha thu leh ami Israelte thu ah ani omdan bang zel a, agamtat theihna ding in hiai ka thugen, TOUPA ma a ngetna ka tutte sun leh zan in TOUPA i Pathian ma ah om gige hen.
english: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before Yahweh, be near to Yahweh our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires;

paite: TOUPA Pathian ahi a, kuamah dang a-om kei uh chih leitung a mite'n atheihtheihna ding in.
english: that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh himself is God. There is no one else.

paite: Huchi in adan thuseh bang a om ding leh athupiakte zui ding in TOUPA i Pathian lam ah na lungtangte uh hoihkim hen, tuni a bang in.”
english: “Let your heart therefore be perfect with Yahweh our God, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”

paite: Israel tengteng leh Solomon in TOUPA ma ah kithoihna alan uhi.
heading: Tempul Latna / (2 Kro 7.4-10)
english: The king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before Yahweh.

paite: Solomon in TOUPA a dia alat kilemna kithoihna ding in bawngtal singnih-le-sangnih leh belam nuaikhat-le-singnih ahi. Huchibang in kumpipa leh Israel suan tengteng in TOUPA' inn alan uhi.
english: Solomon offered for the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered to Yahweh, twenty two thousand head of cattle and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huai ni mah in kumpipa'n TOUPA inka zawn a intual huangsung laitak ahihsiangthou hi. Huai ah halmang thillatte, tangbuang thillatte, kilemna thillat thaute alan hi. Aziak bel huai halmang thillatte, tangbuang thillatte, kilemna thillat sathaute huai dal maitam atat zoh louh ziak ahi.
english: The same day the king made the middle of the court holy that was before Yahweh’s house; for there he offered the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that was before Yahweh was too little to receive the burnt offering, the meal offering, and the fat of the peace offerings.

paite: Huchi in huai hun in Solomon leh Israel tengteng, mipi kikhawm tampi, Hamath lutna a pan Aigupta gam lui pha a mite'n TOUPA i Pathian ma ah ni sagih leh ni sagih, ni sawm-le-li sung ankuang aluikhawm uhi.
english: So Solomon held the feast at that time, and all Israel with him, a great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Egypt, before Yahweh our God, seven days and seven more days, even fourteen days.

paite: Ani giat ni in mipite akikhensak a, amau kumpipa avualzawl ua, huchi in TOUPA'N asikha David leh ami Israelte tung a ahoihna huchi lawmlawm a alatsak ziak in lungsim nuamsa leh kipak mahmah in a-inn lam uah apaita uhi.
english: On the eighth day he sent the people away; and they blessed the king, and went to their tents joyful and glad in their hearts for all the goodness that Yahweh had shown to David his servant, and to Israel his people.
